title: TikTok Partner: The Complete Guide to Partner Center, Apps, and Agency Programs
summary: Learn everything about TikTok Partner: how to log in, download the partner app, meet partner requirements, and choose between agency, developer, and affiliate programs.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### How can a business make $1,000 a month from TikTok?


Focus on TikTok Shop products, recruit creators who match your niche, and track GMV per creator so you can double down on what converts. Platforms like Reacher automate discovery and outreach so you can scale creator partnerships instead of managing them by hand.


### What does an agency do on TikTok?


A TikTok agency partner helps businesses plan, run, and optimize marketing activity on the platform, from ad campaigns to creator collaborations. Agencies typically manage client accounts, creative strategy, and performance reporting. Membership in the Marketing Partner Program does not automatically grant access to other TikTok partner portals, so confirm the exact program before applying.


### What is the partner app for TikTok?


There is no single universal TikTok partner app for every program. Partner access is usually through a web-based portal like Partner Center, while TikTok's consumer and seller-facing apps serve different purposes. Always check the official program instructions for a supported mobile application before downloading anything from an app store.


### How do you get a TikTok sponsorship?


To get a TikTok sponsorship, build a consistent content niche, grow an engaged audience, and pitch brands whose products fit your viewers. Brands prioritize creators with demonstrated sales or conversion performance, so showcasing TikTok Shop GMV or campaign results strengthens your pitch. Applying through official TikTok partner programs is another route for businesses rather than individual creators.


### How much do TikTok sponsorships pay?


TikTok sponsorship pay varies widely based on audience size, engagement rate, niche, and deliverables, so there is no fixed rate. Micro creators often start with product samples or small fees, while established creators command higher payments tied to GMV or reach. Brands running affiliate programs often pay per sale, which ties compensation directly to measurable performance.


### What is TikTok Partner Center?


TikTok Partner Center is a web-based workspace for businesses enrolled in specific TikTok partner programs. It is not a general name for every TikTok marketing or Shop partnership, and the tools available depend on your program, market, and account type. Confirm the exact program name on TikTok's official pages before signing in.


### Why can't I log in to TikTok Partner Center?


TikTok Partner Center login failures usually come from using the wrong portal, signing in with an unregistered account, or missing user permissions. Verify the portal address against the official program page, confirm the email used during registration, and ask your organization's administrator to review your role before resetting credentials.
